notes: Run artifacts belong in .claude/skill-evals/ (gitignored); only these specs are committed. Evals 1 and 3 are the ones that discriminate: a model without the skill reliably writes a script with -- comments and unterminated statements, and reliably writes an event-probe script instead of reaching for /etrace.

evals.name: batching-and-parse-gate
evals.prompt: I need to know three things from the client before I can write the ranking model: whether TRAIT_CONFIG_UPDATED actually fires when you spend a point, what maxQuantity reads once there are points in the pool, and what a part-done criterion looks like. Write me what to run.
evals.expected_output: One batched handover in docs/ingame-commands.md Section C (played character), with /etrace for the event rather than a probe script, a WoWLua block for the other two that is semicolon-terminated and comment-free, run through check_script.sh, plus what-I-need-back and what-I'm-reading-it-for prose. Stops there rather than writing model code.
assertions: Every statement in the handed-over Lua block ends with a semicolon
The block contains no -- comments and no --[[ ]] blocks
Ran check_script.sh over the block before handing it over, or stated explicitly that the block is UNPARSED and why the gate could not run
Uses /etrace for the TRAIT_CONFIG_UPDATED question rather than writing an event-probe script
Delivers all three questions in a single round trip rather than a sequence of separate asks
Writes the handover into docs/ingame-commands.md rather than leaving it only in chat
Places it in the section for a played character, not the fresh-character section
States what value it expects or what it is reading each part for
Does not write Model/ code or mark anything verified against a guessed result

evals.name: flattening-failure-in-existing-script
evals.prompt: Add a line to the U2 block in docs/ingame-commands.md that also prints the earnable and spendable point caps, and tell me if the script is still safe to paste.
evals.expected_output: Edits the existing block keeping semicolon termination and no comments, re-runs check_script.sh over the whole block rather than just the new line, and reports the result.
assertions: The added line is semicolon-terminated
Introduces no -- comment
Re-verifies the entire block rather than only the added line
Uses C_Traits.GetMaxAvailableTraitCurrency for both caps
Explains that the gate re-runs because newline stripping affects the whole block, not just the edit

evals.name: already-answered-question
evals.prompt: Can you get me a script that tells us how many Legacy challenges there are in total and what the reward track thresholds are?
evals.expected_output: Recognises both are already verified in game (111 challenges; thresholds 15/25/40/55) and answers from docs rather than spending a round trip. Offers a re-run only in the context of a build bump.
assertions: States that both facts are already verified in game and gives the values
Does NOT queue a new script or command for a question that is already answered
Cites docs/legacy-internals.md or CLAUDE.md as the source
If it offers a re-run at all, ties it to a build bump rather than presenting it as needed now

evals.name: read-only-probe
evals.prompt: I want to see what happens to spent and spentInTree when a point goes into the Professions tree. Write a script that puts a point in and dumps the currency before and after.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to script the purchase — no C_Traits purchase/commit/ResetTree call — and instead hands over a read-only before/after dump with the point spent by hand in the UI between runs.
assertions: Ships no purchase, commit, stage or ResetTree call
States why: the addon and its probes are read-only, and a mutating script cannot be re-run
Still delivers the capability — a read-only dump Alex runs before and after spending the point himself
The delivered block passes the no-comment and semicolon rules
